Apply non-aggressive (or aggressive) ICA-AROMA denoising to MEDuSA time-series or confound objects

Source: R/fmriprep_bids.R
apply_aroma.Rd

Removes ICA-AROMA motion/artifact components in memory using vectorized QR least-squares projection across all voxels simultaneously, without writing intermediate 4D NIfTIs to disk or breaking MEDuSA's continuous acquisition clock.

Usage

apply_aroma(
  x,
  aroma = NULL,
  mixing = NULL,
  classification = NULL,
  mode = c("nonaggressive", "aggressive"),
  clean_nuisance = TRUE,
  fit_valid_rows = FALSE,
  valid_rows = NULL,
  preserve_mean = TRUE,
  force = FALSE
)

Arguments

x

Target object to denoise: a "medusa_nifti_ts" object (updates $bold and, when clean_nuisance = TRUE, attached $nuisance/$confounds), a "medusa_confounds" object (updates $nuisance), a run-named list of T x V numeric BOLD matrices, or a single T x V numeric matrix.

aroma

Optional "medusa_aroma" object from read_fmriprep_aroma. Required unless mixing is supplied directly.

mixing

Optional MELODIC mixing file path(s) or T x K matrix / list of matrices passed to read_fmriprep_aroma when aroma is NULL.

classification

Optional component classification path(s), metrics data.frame, logical mask, or 1-based integer vector of rejected ICs passed to read_fmriprep_aroma when aroma is NULL.

mode

Denoising projection mode: "nonaggressive" (default; Pruim et al., 2015 partial regression protecting accepted signal ICs) or "aggressive" (full orthogonal projection of rejected ICs only).

clean_nuisance

Logical; if TRUE (default) and x is a "medusa_nifti_ts" object with $confounds or $nuisance attached, applies the identical AROMA projection to nuisance columns so downstream joint regression cannot re-introduce removed motion variance.

fit_valid_rows

Logical; if TRUE, fits AROMA component weights using only uncensored valid_rows while projecting across all rows. Default FALSE fits across full continuous MELODIC run series (matching FSL fsl_regfilt, Pruim et al., 2015, and BrainGnomes).

valid_rows

Optional logical vector or run-named list of logical masks used when fit_valid_rows = TRUE (defaults to x$valid_rows when present on x).

preserve_mean

Logical; if TRUE (default), preserves each voxel's temporal mean across fitted timepoints. Ignored for "medusa_confounds" inputs (which follow x$settings$center).

force

Logical; if TRUE, re-applies AROMA even when metadata or BrainGnomes provenance indicates AROMA was already executed. Default FALSE.

Value

Object of the same class and structure as x with denoised signal matrices and AROMA diagnostic metadata attached (x$aroma on "medusa_nifti_ts", x$settings$aroma on "medusa_confounds", or attr(x, "aroma") on plain matrices / lists).

Details

Under mode = "nonaggressive" (the default; Pruim et al., 2015; matching FSL fsl_regfilt and BrainGnomes), all accepted and rejected MELODIC components are fit jointly with an intercept (\(Y = \mathbf{1}\mu^\top + M_{\mathrm{acc}} B_{\mathrm{acc}} + M_{\mathrm{rej}} B_{\mathrm{rej}} + E\)), and only the partial contribution of rejected components (\(\tilde{M}_{\mathrm{rej}} \hat{B}_{\mathrm{rej}}\)) is subtracted. Shared variance between task-evoked neural components (\(M_{\mathrm{acc}}\)) and task-correlated motion components (\(M_{\mathrm{rej}}\)) is therefore retained rather than attenuated, and temporal degrees of freedom in Step 1 (estimate_crossrun_hrf) and Step 2 (deconvolve_crossrun_hrf) are not consumed by dozens of ICA columns. When clean_nuisance = TRUE, attached nuisance regressors ($nuisance / $confounds) receive the identical AROMA projection so downstream joint nuisance regression cannot re-introduce AROMA motion variance (Lindquist et al., 2019).

See also

read_fmriprep_aroma, read_fmriprep_subject, read_fmriprep_confounds, estimate_crossrun_hrf

Examples

set.seed(1)
s_task <- sin(seq(0, 6 * pi, length.out = 80))
m_motion <- 0.5 * s_task + rnorm(80, sd = 0.6)
mix <- cbind(IC_01 = s_task, IC_02 = m_motion, IC_03 = rnorm(80))
Y <- 500 + cbind(v1 = 2.0 * s_task + 1.5 * m_motion, v2 = 1.0 * s_task - 0.8 * m_motion) +
  matrix(rnorm(160, sd = 0.05), 80, 2)

ar <- read_fmriprep_aroma(mix, classification = 2L)
Y_clean <- apply_aroma(Y, ar, mode = "nonaggressive")
attr(Y_clean, "aroma")$summary
#>    run          mode n_volumes n_fit_volumes n_components n_accepted n_rejected
#> 1 run1 nonaggressive        80            80            3          2          1
#>   applied mean_pct_var_removed median_pct_var_removed
#> 1    TRUE             7.811599               7.811599
